text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin and I are preparing to head
back
after training, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice that she's looking toward the
sunset.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I bet everyone's eat'n dinner right about
now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No! I've gotta stay focused on what
I'm doing
here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I need a favor from you! You've
gotta let
me train a li'l more!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna live up to the exp'ctations of all
the
people support'n me back home!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be someone people talk about
over
dinner, and it brightens up their
whole day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch! Now watch this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if running off all her worries, Yukino
Bijin
continues training hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, true. I guess this's what they mean
when they
say slow 'n' steady wins the
race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You got it! I'll rest up so that the next
time y'see
me, I'll be bright-eyed and
bushy-tailed!
